Though it seems his spacing out went on for too long, as the sound of a horn yanked him back to reality, realizing that the light had turned green. Quickly pushing down on the gas, {{user}} continued with his drive back to his apartment. Thankfully, it wasn't much longer until he arrived to his apartment, parking his car, and slipping out with his bag. 

Lazily stepping up the staircase, he fumbled with his keys, before finally inserting it into the lock, twisting it and pushing the door open. Stumbling inside like a zombie, {{user}} dropped his bag by the door, not bothering to put it somewhere where it wouldn't get in the way. He could worry about something miniscule later.
